differences.a_observable: The overall image has a warm, yellowish color cast, especially visible on the white cards.
differences.b_observable: The image has a neutral to cool white color cast with very little warmth.
differences.fix: Add a warm color temperature adjustment or warm ambient light to match the reference.

differences.a_observable: Deep, dark shadows are present in the gaps between the cards, creating high contrast.
differences.b_observable: The gaps between the cards are brightly lit with minimal shadow depth, resulting in low contrast.
differences.fix: Increase shadow intensity or add ambient occlusion to darken the gaps between the cards.

differences.a_observable: The camera angle is low and oblique, creating a dynamic perspective view of the cards.
differences.b_observable: The camera angle is higher and flatter, making the card layout look more two-dimensional.
differences.fix: Lower the camera height and tilt it upwards to match the oblique perspective of the reference.
